integrity: The foundational nine-page Chen-Lee paper was inspected directly, including the normalized equations, sign condition, symmetries, dissipativity calculation, and reported attractors and limit cycles. A later full equilibrium-analysis manuscript was inspected for the five-equilibrium formula and searched for invariant-measure and average terminology. The exact polynomial identities and classical parameter arithmetic were replayed from the packaged standard-library checker. The accepted claim does not rely on numerical trajectory experiments.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes abc is nonzero; zero-parameter degeneracies are excluded.
The criterion concerns non-origin compact invariant probability measures, not arbitrary bounded connecting orbits.
Sufficiency is provided by nonzero equilibrium atoms and does not assert existence of chaos for every admissible sign triple.
The Hamilton-Poisson literature treats special integrable parameter choices that are not classified here beyond the accepted all-parameter statement.
A differently phrased stationary-balance observation in unindexed literature could remain unlocated.
title: Sharp stationary sign criterion and exact coordinatewise flux laws for the Chen–Lee flow
